note: Engineering gate, not legal advice. Anything in 'review' needs a recorded acceptance; anything unknown or in 'deny' blocks the gate. A named legal reviewer must confirm before external redistribution.

acceptances.psycopg: LGPL-3.0-only. Imported unmodified as a separate, replaceable Python package (dynamic use); the platform's own code stays under its own licence. Obligations for redistribution (notice, ability to replace the library) must be met in packaging (M8 runbook). Legal review pending.
acceptances.psycopg-binary: LGPL-3.0-only. Same position as psycopg; ships libpq inside the wheel, so its notices travel with the wheel. Legal review pending.
acceptances.pathspec: MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft). Development tool dependency of linters; not shipped in the runtime image.
acceptances.@axe-core/playwright: MPL-2.0. Test-only accessibility tooling; not shipped.
acceptances.axe-core: MPL-2.0. Test-only accessibility tooling; not shipped.
acceptances.lightningcss: MPL-2.0. Build-time CSS tooling pulled by the bundler; not shipped in the runtime image (only its output is).
acceptances.pgserver: Licence metadata is missing in the package, so it is UNKNOWN to this gate. Development/test harness only (embedded PostgreSQL for tests); never shipped. Verify its upstream licence before any redistribution of the dev environment.
acceptances.certifi: MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft). Pulled only by the test HTTP client (httpx); not shipped in the runtime image.
acceptances.colorama: Licence metadata is absent in the installed package, so it is UNKNOWN to this gate. Terminal-colour helper pulled by dev tooling only; not shipped. Upstream licence is believed to be BSD-3-Clause (not verified here).
acceptances.tzdata: Licence metadata unreadable (not installed on this platform). Pulled only on Windows (psycopg marker sys_platform == 'win32'), which is not a supported deployment platform; excluded from the runtime closure. Upstream licence is believed to be Apache-2.0 (not verified here). Re-check if Windows is ever supported.

acceptance_prefixes.lightningcss-: MPL-2.0 platform binaries of lightningcss: same position as lightningcss (build-time only).
